issues: Static validation fails the accessibility check (serious) for Expo app: icons rendered as <div role="img"> lack alternative text. The test suite expects all accessibility checks to pass. Icons (FontAwesome, React Native Paper, etc.) must be hidden from the accessibility tree (e.g., aria-hidden, accessible={false}) or provided with appropriate labels as described in the warning. Update the icon components or PaperProvider settings to suppress or label the icons.
